title: Could you tell me where it is?

questions.context: You’re asking a stranger about the last train
questions.prompt: Which question has natural indirect word order?

options.text: Could you tell me when does the last train leave?
Could you tell me when the last train leaves?

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: After could you tell me, use statement word order

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: After could you tell me, use statement word order

questions.context: You want to know whether the museum is open

options.text: Do you know if the museum is open?
Do you know is the museum open?

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: If introduces an indirect yes-or-no question

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: If introduces an indirect yes-or-no question

questions.context: The receptionist has already explained the route, but you missed one detail
questions.prompt: Which request is clear and polite?

options.text: Could you repeat where I need to change?
Tell me again everything you said before

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Ask for the specific missing detail

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Ask for the specific missing detail

questions.context: You need help with a heavy bag
questions.prompt: Which request asks without assuming agreement?

options.text: You don’t mind helping me, do it now
Would you mind helping me with this bag?

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Would you mind asks politely about doing something

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Would you mind asks politely about doing something

questions.context: Someone says, “Would you mind waiting here?” You agree

options.text: Not at all. I’ll wait here
Yes, I mind. I’ll wait here

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Not at all makes it clear you don’t object

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Not at all makes it clear you don’t object

questions.context: You want to check the cost before agreeing

options.text: Could you let me know how much does it cost?
Could you let me know how much it costs?

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Keep statement word order inside the indirect question

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Keep statement word order inside the indirect question

phrases.displayText: Could you tell me where the guided tour starts?
phrases.translation: Pode me dizer onde começa a visita guiada?

phrases.displayText: At the reception desk at ten. The talk is later, at eleven thirty
phrases.translation: Na recepção às dez. A palestra é depois, às onze e meia

phrases.displayText: Do you know if the tour is included in the entrance fee?
phrases.translation: Você sabe se a visita está incluída no ingresso?

phrases.displayText: The standard tour is included. The special workshop costs extra
phrases.translation: A visita normal está incluída. A oficina especial custa à parte

phrases.displayText: Thanks. Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?
phrases.translation: Obrigada. Pode me dizer onde posso deixar minha bolsa?

phrases.displayText: There’s a cloakroom on the ground floor, beside the information point
phrases.translation: Tem um guarda-volumes no térreo, ao lado do ponto de informações

phrases.displayText: And is the talk still in room two?
phrases.translation: E a palestra continua na sala dois?

phrases.displayText: That’s what the timetable says. Please check the board before you go
phrases.translation: É o que diz a programação. Confira o quadro antes de ir
